Browave.why: Browave sells fiber harnesses / FAUs and jumpers for 800G/1.6T AI data-center transceivers and fiber shuffle boxes for CPO platforms; optical-interconnect buildout drives its revenue.
Browave.evidence: Browave 2026 investor conference deck (03-10-2026): OIN (33% of 2025 revenue) supplies custom 800G/1.6T jumpers for AI servers and new fiber shuffle boxes for CPO platforms; CPO fiber harness and shuffle box products expected to enter mass production in 2H 2026.

players.product: Passive optical components: fiber harnesses / fiber array units (FAU) for 800G/1.6T pluggable transceivers (FR and DR), 800G/1.6T and MMC jumpers, and CPO fiber shuffle boxes and high-channel-count FAUs; WDM and branch (splitter) modules for PON/FTTH and CATV

quarterly_data.signal: Browave reported August 2026 consolidated net revenue of NT$205,091 thousand, up 9.69% from NT$186,973 thousand a year earlier; January-August 2026 revenue NT$1,663,101 thousand, up 17.73% from NT$1,412,648 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Aug 2026 NT$205,091 thousand (+9.69% YoY); Jan-Aug NT$1,663,101 thousand (+17.73%)
